description: DRAFT (2026-11-12, the ply-2 prep fork; NOT LAUNCHED; PENDING DECISION 2, the user's: rungs above ply 1 warm or from scratch) of the TRAINING STANDARD v1, ply-2 rung (models/STANDARD.md, analyst 6.95; the user, 11-12 ~17:00: "First let's establish the standard for ply 1. then we can move onto ply 2"). WARM run s2 (seed 68): every line starts from its own line's final in std-v1-p1-s2 (the ply-1 rung, same seed slot), version 0 a byte copy of that final (trees: model and training state). The start version is null in this draft: python3 models/from-scratch/std-v1-p2/prep/fill_p2_starts.py s2 writes leagues/specs/standard/std-v1-p2-s2.json with it once std-v1-p1-s2 is done (create refuses null). FIRST TRAINING (6.95): start_forget 1 for the probit lines (their variances sit at the tau equilibrium); a one-off forget 10 on the LR lines (F-L: --init-forget 10 on chessai-hybrid6; the LR trees' and DAG's leaves: --start-leaf-forget 10, routers untouched, chessai-grow7); the four growing lines keep their structure and growth state (credits, closes, back-off, router chain) with --warm-reset: leaf trials in flight closed on their statistic so far (kept without one: fewer than 2 finished blocks), DAG router trials closed under their own keep rule (kept without a finished window), windows, snapshots, router shadows and null shadows restarted, path tables kept. Later trainings as usual. chessai-grow7 = chessai-grow6 byte for byte without the two flags (and = chessai-hybrid6 on the capped trees): models/from-scratch/fastbin/grow7/summary.txt. PLATEAU: scaled sqrt, guard_z 1, K 50 training cycles, checked on rated cycles from 41; cap 101 (both rated cycles under rate_every 4). LINES (1 each, mixed field), the ply-1 rung's recipes token for token: F-L; F-P; T-L-Ne capped (limit 4, 1M, forget 10); T-P-Ne capped (limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03); T-L-Ne-grow-f10 (grow-mdl 0, gate age, priority snapshot); T-P-Ne-grow (bar on); D-L-Ne-ctx-grow and D-P-Ne-ctx-grow (router-chain 2, router-trial-z -2; the LR DAG grow-mdl 0, forget 10). Training binaries in the entries (train_binary): chessai-hybrid6 for F-L, F-P and the capped probit tree, chessai-grow7 for the capped LR tree and the four growing lines (the same in s1, s2 and x3; no train_binary.py step after create). PLAY: every game at ply 2 (entry_ply 2, ply1_entries false), games_per_cycle 1584 (16 entries: 7 double round-robins, 1,680 games), round-robins and self-games at T 0.1, every line trains on them; tournament chessai-hybrid20 (2026-11-12 ~19:30: hybrid19 with compound's node cap raised from 64 to 128, byte-identical games at plies 1-5, so DAG lines past 64 nodes play in fixed point: models/from-scratch/fastbin/hybrid20/summary.txt). RATING: rate_every 4 (rated cycles 1, 5, 9, ...), cold games T 0.02 share 0.5, rating only. CROWNING: draw-aware SE, 3. READ (6.95): leagues/specs/standard/std_p2_read.py, warm (s1, s2) against scratch (x3) per recipe and pooled on the ply-2 standing panel y/v/l @299 (stranger fit), early (warm v75, scratch v75 and v150; + the ply-1 panel at ply 2 as a lower tier) and final. PREDICTION (6.95): warm = scratch within 25 at the plateau; warm reaches scratch's v150 level by v50-75. RULE: scratch 30+ over warm at the plateau (pooled) -> rungs start cold; otherwise warm is the rule. COST (measured at ply 2 on the proof runs, models/from-scratch/std-v1-p2/proof: 0.024 CPU-s a game in the warm field (std-v1-p1-s1@340's models) and 0.025 from scratch after cycle 1, so ~41 CPU-s of tournament a cycle at 1,680 games; calibration ~9 (8 lines), self-games ~5, cold games ~4.5 a cycle on average; training ~20 with the ply-1 finals' sizes, ~5 from scratch early): ~80 CPU-s a cycle: ~0.9 CPU-h to the floor (41) and ~2.3 to the cap (101) per warm run, +-30%; both warm runs ~1.8-4.6; the scratch arm ~6 to its floor (301), ~13 to its cap (601). Seeds 67, 68, 69: unused (64 probit-p4w's draft, 65-66 the ply-1 rung).
